dct_title_s: Gestalt des Temples Salomonis mit seinen dreyen Vorhöfen
dct_description_sm: Cartographer and date from dealer's notes.
May be from: Itinerarium sacrae scripturae / Heinrich Bünting. Magdenburg : A. Duncker, 1582.
Oriented with north toward the bottom.
German text on verso has 2 pages with captions: 47 Beschreibung des Tempels; Jerusalem von den Vorhöfen des Tempels 44.
